comparability_notes: Both evaluated models are free-tier entries served through OpenCode Zen under the same scaffold and budget; only the model ID differs.
The two models differ in vendor, release date, open-weight status and context window. This is a comparison of two practically available free code models, not a controlled same-scale comparison.
Do not generalize the result to a vendor ranking; report within-model feedback effects and the between-model interaction separately.
